spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing for data, generous margins between sections.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
spacing_and_layout.surface_style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use sharp edges. border-radius: 0px. Use pure 1px solid borders.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). High contrast. Hover state: lighter hue or invert colors.
components.cards: Cardless or 1px border. No drop shadows. Flat background.
components.tables: Dense rows. Sticky header. Highlight row on hover.
components.inputs: Flat borders, no shadow, sharp corners. Focus ring must be 2px solid primary color.
components.badges: Square corners, solid background, bold uppercase text.

interactions.hover: Explicit text color and background color changes. Slight -translate-y-[1px] for interactive cards.
interactions.focus: High contrast 2px ring. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background.

login.layout: Split screen (50/50). Form on left, brand image on right.
login.visuals: Use login_bg_light or login_bg_dark based on theme.
login.auth: Google OAuth via Emergent (Social Login only).

dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid. 4 top KPI cards (Members, Revenue, Expenses, Active Events). 2 large charts below (Recharts). Recent activities list.

members.features: Data table (TanStack). Visual alerts: Warning badge (Rule of 3 events hit), Danger badge (Unpaid dues). Payment modal for partial membership payments.

events.features: List of upcoming/past tournaments. Event detail page with participant list (up to 150 players) and quick link to POS.

pos.features: Mobile-first tactile grid of products/consumables. Large tap targets. Cart summary on the side/bottom. Cash/Card payment buttons.
pos.layout: 2-column on desktop (Products | Cart). Full width on mobile.

inventory.features: List of consumables and merch. Quantity counters. Low-stock visual indicators (red text or icon).

expenses.features: Table with categories. Form to add new expense.

reports.features: Financial summaries. Recharts for monthly cashflow. Two primary action buttons: Export PDF, Export CSV.

settings.features: Dynamic roles/permissions matrix. General association info.

images.description: Abstract dark mode gaming architectural background
Abstract light mode gaming architectural background

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons. 'Swords' or 'Gamepad2' for the main brand logo. Use specific icons for navigation (Users, Calendar, ShoppingCart, Package, Receipt, BarChart, Settings).

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='nav-members', data-testid='add-expense-btn'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Use primary color carefully to ensure text inside is readable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts for 'Chivo' and 'IBM Plex Sans' via @fontsource or HTML link.
Install recharts for the dashboard and reports charts.
Configure Tailwind with the exact hex codes provided, replacing default radii with 0px (rounded-none).
Build Shadcn components using 'rounded-none' for a strict Swiss design.
For PDF exports, you may use libraries like 'jspdf' or generate a printable view.
For CSV exports, use simple CSV generation functions or a library like 'react-csv'.
Ensure all translations are in French.
In the POS view, make the product grid highly responsive and easy to tap (min-h-[80px] for buttons).
